title: Ult Seven: greens before Cultist (health 4.8k 10.4k, Cultist 12.8k) vs Cultist first (Cultist 8.0k, health 12.8k)
question: Is the 2.4k-earlier health spike worth a 4.8k-later Cultist Sacrifice on the farm ult build?
hypothesis: H-N1: souls at 16 min are >= 600 higher with Cultist first (one extra Cultist cast at 170% bonus souls, +1 ball charge, +12% radius on farm), while survival time vs a gun bot at 10.4k is ~10-15% shorter (HP 1734 vs ~2053 calculated).

arms.name: GREENS_FIRST
arms.notes: variant G at 10.4k (Enduring Speed still 800 short in this snapshot)

setup.position: jungle camp route, then 1v1 vs gun bot

controls: Arms interleaved A,B,A,B; A/A floor run first
Same souls/level per arm; ability tiers set with abil ops per FOUNDATIONS F9 (unlocked 1, T1 3, T2 7, T3 15), logged before each block
Same bot heroes, positions, HP keep-alive and resists
procedure: farm the same 3-camp route for 180 s, record souls
duel phase: time to death vs the shooting bot, no abilities used by player except Power Surge

decision.rule: CULTIST_FIRST farming >= +10% with time_to_death loss < 15% supports keeping Cultist first; otherwise reopen G
